description: This file defines a PHP trait called ModelTrait within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Api\V2\Serializer. The trait provides methods for serializing a model entity into an array, setting filters, attribute names, and the entity object itself. It includes private methods for handling nested arrays and collections during serialization.

methods.name: setFilters
methods.description: Sets the filter array specifying which attributes to include during serialization.

methods.name: setAttributeNames
methods.description: Overrides attribute names for the output array.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity object to be serialized.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the entity into an associative array based on set filters and attribute names.

methods.name: makeNestedArray
methods.description: Recursively constructs nested arrays from keys and associated value.

methods.name: normalizeNestedCollection
methods.description: Normalizes a collection of objects into an array of associative arrays by calling specified getter methods.
